summary: Fixed the ledger package so all 755 tests pass and tools/audit.py reports 0 failed checks. Fixes covered half-away-from-zero rounding, negative-amount formatting, header-over-dialect layout precedence, the rate lookup (earlier months only) and the rate-file month range, reversal booking and valuation dates, tax rule effective dates, summing rounded entry values, fiscal quarters, the HTML total sign and the writer's jurisdiction key. I did not review every module against the conventions note, only the ones the tests and audit exercise plus a skim of the rest.
